about: The home page, as one noun: the film (one or more cuts, with a default), a statement in two labelled parts (the use case and the architecture underneath), a 1x3 product hub across the ecosystem, and the decks. The first part's line is the page's heading. scripts/build_site.py renders it into site/index.html.
title: Agora, the ta-amps overview
description: Agora is the ta-amps overview: the three-minute film, the 1x3 product hub, interactive Task and Task-Object explorer, five decks, use cases and how the system is built to keep learning. The use case is Eranos, spare tokens for good. The architecture underneath is nouns and verbs: verbs are tasks, and nouns are task objects.

hub.kicker: Three pillars on one shared engine
hub.heading: The 1x3 Product Hub
hub.lead: Start where you need help, explore the shared Task and Task-Object engine, or connect your own harness and fine-tune open-weights Meta specialists.

pillars.title: 1. Public Goods Marketplace
pillars.summary: Nonprofits describe what they need in plain words on Eranos. Donated agents answer public-data questions with verified citations (drafter != reviewer) and build local agent kits so private files never go to Eranos or volunteers.

pillars.title: 2. Task & Task-Object Engine
pillars.summary: Tessera shards leased Tasks (verbs) across q01..q16 queues and CAS Task Objects (nouns) so multi-harness worker swarms (up to 256 concurrent workers, verifier != builder) coordinate with SHA-256 receipts, while Herma shims context in < 2 ms.

pillars.title: 3. Roll Your Own: Seed Packs, Harness Feeds & Meta Fine-Tuning
pillars.summary: Compose seed packs, track HarnessTax across Harness Square, OpenCode, Pi, and Muse Code, and route across a 4-tier compute cascade: Herma rules, local Llama 3.2 modular LoRAs, Kaggle 2xT4 Muse Glimmer 30B QLoRA, and Muse Spark 1.3.
